thread:
elaine: Kicking off v4.1.0 rollout to eu-west in the 09:00-11:00 change window. Routes: embeddings, rerank, text-gen. Step plan: 5 steps, start at 4% per route.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started · job_id=rl-20260415-41 · step=1 · weights={v4.1.0:4,v4.0.3:96}
raja: Quick heads-up watching dashboards — embeddings.p99 shows an odd tail bump at step start (980ms -> 2.1s) but p95 is fine. Link: https://console.redwood/slo/embeddings?range=10m
mike: That's curious — rerank shows p95 stable but error-rate for rerank.ratelimit is up (429s). Could be client mismatch with new token expiry headers.
slo-bot: [alert] cross-route anomaly detected: embeddings.p99 > anomaly_threshold && rerank.429_rate elevation · recommend=run-probes-and-hold-affected-routes
elaine: Hold on embeddings and rerank ramps only. Keep text-gen stepping. Run targeted probes: 0.5% traffic for embeddings (tail-focused) and 1% for rerank (error reproduction).
deploy-bot: [automated] action=hold_rollout · job_id=rl-20260415-41 · affected=[embeddings,rerank]
deploy-bot: [automated] run_probe · probe_id=probe-7165423100-e · route=embeddings · target_version=v4.1.0 · traffic=0.5% · duration=180s
deploy-bot: [automated] run_probe · probe_id=probe-7165423100-r · route=rerank · target_version=v4.1.0 · traffic=1% · duration=120s
raja: Embeddings probe traces show sporadic long tails from worker X on attention-kernel loop, correlates with gc pause logs: https://traces.redwood/probe-7165423100-e · grep timestamps ~7165423120
mike: Rerank probe reproduces 429s from upstream mesh when the new header is present. Trace: https://traces.redwood/probe-7165423100-r 
elaine: Given two separate regressions (embedding tail from runtime, rerank 429 from mesh header compatibility), I propose route-level pins: pin embeddings to v4.0.3 and rerank to v3.9.8 for eu-west. Keep text-gen on v4.1.0 ramping.
raja: Agreed. I'll apply weights for embeddings first and include an audit comment.
raja: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/route-weight -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"embeddings","weights":{"v4.1.0":0,"v4.0.3":100}}'`  # applied
audit-bot: [log] action=route-weight-change · user=raja · route=embeddings · from={v4.1.0:4} · to={v4.0.3:100} · ts=7165423142
deploy-bot: [automated] weights_updated · route=embeddings · job_id=rl-20260415-41-weights-e
raja: Embeddings p99 dropping back under 1s within ~40s. Good.
mike: Applying rerank pin now to v3.9.8 for eu-west. `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/route-weight -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"rerank","weights":{"v4.1.0":0,"v3.9.8":100}}'`  # applied
audit-bot: [log] action=route-weight-change · user=mike · route=rerank · from={v4.1.0:4} · to={v3.9.8:100} · ts=7165423160
deploy-bot: [automated] weights_updated · route=rerank · job_id=rl-20260415-41-weights-r
mike: rerank 429s fall to baseline within a minute. Text-gen continues ramping without issue.
elaine: Update release notes: "v4.1.0: embeddings and rerank paused in eu-west due to route-specific regressions; routes pinned to v4.0.3 (embeddings) and v3.9.8 (rerank). text-gen continues. Follow-ups: ENG-5587 (runtime GC attention-kernel triage), ENG-5588 (mesh header compatibility)."
raja: Added ENG-5587 and assigned to eng-runtime. Also flagged ci/perf to add a long-tail embedding stress test.
elaine: Leave rollout job rl-20260415-41 open but blocked for embeddings+rerank. We'll resume after triage and bench sign-off. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
